title: Business Management 2
duration: 45 hours of lectures + 105 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic concepts of business management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to understand and recognize fundamental issues related to business management.
Students will develop independent working skills, communication skills, and teamwork abilities.
Students will have the ability to analyze and solve practical problems in business with leadership and management skills.
Students will have the ability to independently research, study, accumulate, and improve their professional knowledge.
Students will understand ethical responsibilities and social obligations.
